paragraphs.text: When by their punishment I called them from their iniquity.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Except you repent your former cruelty.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: That is, to their former estate.
paragraphs.label: d
e
paragraphs.anchor: These two nations and these two

paragraphs.text: And so by fighting against God's people they should go about to put him out of his own possession.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: As you have done cruelly, so will you be cruelly handled.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Showing that when God punishes the enemies, the godly ought to consider that he has a care over them and so praise his name: and also that the wicked rage as though there were no God, till they feel his hand to their destruction.
